VDD_SYS_GPU.description: Tegra GPU & SRAM, GPU supply input

VDD_SYS_SOC.description: VDD_SYS_SOC_IN, SOC supply input. Powers the display adapter, ISP, NVDEC, NVENC, VIC

VDD_IN.description: VDD_IN Supply Monitor. It powers all other rails (VDD_SYS_CPU, VDD_SYS_DDR, VDD_SYS_GPU, VDD_SYS_SOC, VDD_4V0_WIFI)

VDD_MUX.description: DC Jack to Carrier Board. Powers the VDD_5V0_IO_SYS and VDD_3V3_SYS rails. Does NOT power the VDD_IN rail in the TX2 module.

VDD_3V3_IO_SLP.description: 3V3 RUN RAIL. VDD_3V3_SLP on the carrier board schematic. Powers the 3.3V input of the SATA connector, display connector (pin 16), camera expansion (pins 84, 108, 110),2.8 V for the camera.

VDD_1V8_IO.description: 1.8V SYSTEM. VDD_1V8 on the carrier board schematic
